fields.label: First Name
fields.description: Snapshot of the student's FIRST name at share time — the only identity the public verify surface ever shows

fields.label: Score
fields.description: The 0-100 Readiness Score snapshot (readiness_rules formula) frozen at share time

fields.label: Band
fields.description: Display band derived from the score at share time (Exam Ready / On Track / Building / Needs Focus)

fields.label: Components JSON
fields.description: Per-component percentages behind the snapshot — audit only, NEVER exposed on the public verify surface

fields.label: Period Month
fields.description: As-of month (1-12) the snapshot was computed in

fields.label: Token
fields.description: Cryptographically random share token (secrets.token_urlsafe) — the only public handle to this snapshot

fields.label: Revoked
fields.description: A revoked share's verify link and card stop resolving; the row stays for audit
